title: Deliver completes hygiene when only the CI final reset failed
body:
Outcome: krn deliver finishes hygiene when the merged head's krn/gate reports gate=true but only the Jenkins final reset failed, and reports the infra failure separately (exit and task pointer).
Evidence: PR #164 deliver exited 74 on main 8961311 ('Final reset failed; quarantine remains', gate=true); the lead redid hygiene by hand from src/deliver/delivery.ts:734-780 (review-series archive, worktree remove, ff main, branch delete), then archived orphaned runs.
Proof: a deliver test with a captured check-run summary 'gate=true; cleanup=false' reaches hygiene and exits with a distinct infra code; a gate=false summary still stops at ci.
